articles.title: Football Daily - England beat Czech Republic - 5 Live Reaction - BBC Sounds
articles.summary: It was a 2-0 win for Thomas Tuchel’s side
articles.body:
Radio 5 Live , · 29 Sep 2026 , · 30 mins

Kelly Somers is joined by former England internationals Paul Robinson and Stephen Warnock to react to England’s Nations League win over the Czech Republic, where Anthony Gordon got the opener with Harry Kane getting the second. The guys dissect England’s performance – and discuss how important it was to keep a clean sheet. Anthony Gordon was hailed the player of the match by Paul Robinson and they look at where improvements could be made in the team. The chat also turns to Trent Alexander-Arnold who made his first start for his country in two years. They hear from Alex Scott, who made his debut for England as well as captain Harry Kane too. Even Thomas Tuchel pops up on the pod for a chat with John Murray! On Saturday England take on Croatia away in the Nations League, commentary on 5 live from 5pm. Timecodes: 10:00 – Anthony Gordon focus. 14:10 – Alex Scott interview. 19:00 – Harry Kane interview. 25:45 – Thomas Tuchel interview.

articles.title: NFL injury tracker Week 3: Latest news, fantasy implications as Sam Darnold (glute) 'ready to go', Caleb Williams (hamstring) ruled out, Puka Nacua (hip) unlikely to play
articles.summary: Here's everything you need to know injury-wise for Week 3 of the NFL season.
articles.body: Week 3 is underway, and we're tracking all the injuries heading into the weekend.Jump to a team:AFC East: Bills | Dolphins | Patriots | JetsAFC North: Ravens | Bengals | Browns | SteelersAFC South: Texans | Colts | Jaguars | TitansAFC West: Broncos | Chiefs | Raiders | ChargersNFC East: Cowboys | Giants | Eagles | CommandersNFC North: Bears | Lions | Packers (played Thurs.) | VikingsNFC South: Falcons (played Thurs.) | Panthers | Saints | BuccaneersNFC West: Cardinals | Rams | 49ers | SeahawksLive injury updatesThe Seattle Seahawks will have their No. 1 quarterback on Sunday when they take on the Washington Commanders. Sam Darnold, who suffered a glute injury during the opening game of the season, was back at practice on Thursday as a full participant, and was off the injury report on Friday.In Darnold's absence, Drew Lock threw for 187 yards and a touchdown during Seattle's Week 1 win over the New England Patriots. He followed that up during last week's win over the Arizona Cardinals with 235 passing yards and three touchdowns.Head coach Mike Macdonald had said Darnold is "on a good track right now" to play in Week 3; on Friday, he said that Darnold is "ready to go."Caleb Williams (hamstring) has been ruled out and Tyson Bagent (concussion) is questionable to play Monday night against the Philadelphia Eagles. Williams left Week 2 with the injury and is considered week-to-week. Bagent practiced on Saturday, but remains in concussion protocol as part of the process. Case Keenum will either start or serve as Bagent's backup.Other Week 3 injuries to monitor:The Washington Commanders and Jayden Daniels got good news with the quarterback not requiring surgery on his injured elbow. General manager Adam Peters said Friday that an operation is "not on the table" and that they have not talked about placing Daniels on injured reserve, which would rule him out for at least four weeks.Nico Collins has been ruled out by the Houston Texans as he deals with a Grade 1 hamstring strain. Like Collins, Zay Flowers of the Baltimore Ravens also missed Week 2 and remained out of practice this week. He is listed as questionable for their game in Brazil.Los Angeles Rams wide receiver Puka Nacua sat out Friday's practice and is doubtful for Sunday night. Head coach Sean McVay said this week Nacua was "not making great progress" with the hip/groin issue that kept him out of Week 2. McVay added they expect Nacua to be ready to return next week.After being ruled out for the season with a knee injury, New York Giants quarterback Jaxson Dart underwent surgery on Friday to repair his meniscus. According to The Athletic's Dan Duggan, Dart also suffered damage to his MCL and PCL, which will be addressed if needed. articles.title: College football scores, live updates: Oregon vs. USC, Texas A&M vs. LSU and more
articles.summary: After a wild first few weeks of the college football season, we may have our best slate yet in Week 4.
articles.body: After a wild first few weeks of the college football season, we may have our best slate yet in Week 4. Saturday features six matchups between teams ranked in the AP Top 25.The day started with a marquee showdown between No. 1 Texas and No. 14 Tennessee, and the Longhorns won rights to the 'UT' moniker with a tough defensive performance. Texas' Colin Simmons tied a school record with five sacks in a 20-17 win — though he did get in a bit of trouble after his first. No. 17 Iowa provided the drama for the day in the afternoon, driving the length of the field in the final minute and scoring on a walk-off TD pass from Hank Brown to Reece Vander Zee as time expired to beat No. 18 Michigan 20-19. Elsewhere, No. 4 Ole Miss got shelled by No. 21 Florida and No. 15 Utah held on for a 31-17 win at Iowa State.In the evening, we have a trifecta of ranked-on-ranked matchups with No. 23 Texas A&M vs. No. 10 LSU, No. 20 Oregon vs. No. 12 USC and No. 19 Missouri vs. No. 24 Mississippi State. It's an action-packed slate that surely won't disappoint.Follow all of the action with live updates, highlights and analysis below:

articles.title: AEW All Out 2026 live results: Updates, grades, analysis for Will Ospreay vs. Jon Moxley
articles.summary: Follow AEW All Out 2026 live results and match-by-match updates as AEW heads to Illinois with a stacked card, topped by the AEW World Championship match between Will Ospreay and Jon Moxley.
articles.body: AEW All Out 2026 follows AEW's historic night in London with another stacked show featuring seven title matches, headlined by the first defense of new world champion Will Ospreay. He'll be tasked with beating his latest mentor and the winningest AEW World Champion in company history, Jon Moxley. Follow AEW All Out 2026 live results, match-by-match updates, grades, winners and losers and more all day here with Uncrowned.Ospreay's coronation was a foregone conclusion in a home game at All In, after which the question quickly became: Who will challenge "The Aerial Assassin" first? Moxley, who won that same night, rose to the occasion, and now pursues yet another reign as AEW's lead man. Several story beats between the two have been strong since Ospreay's neck injury last year, and it all comes to a head in Saturday's All Out main event.Another title matchup likely to steal the show belongs to the tag-team division, where gold is up for grabs in a three-way ladder match. The champions, Cage and Cope, look to make even more history by replicating their famous TLC matches from the early 2000s; they'll be challenged by former AEW champions the Young Bucks and FTR.AEW International Champion Kazuchika Okada is additionally set to defend his title against Tommaso Ciampa in a true fantasy match. For years, the wrestlers couldn't have been farther apart from ever colliding; now, they'll go at it for Okada's AEW crown.Check out the full AEW All Out 2026 lineup below, which starts at 8 p.m. ET on HBO Max, Prime Video, PPV.com, Triller, Fite TV, Fubo, Sling TV, YouTube, DAZN (internationally) and MyAEW.com:AEW World Championship: Will Ospreay (c) vs. Jon MoxleyLadder Match for the AEW World Tag Team Championships: Cage and Cope (Christian Cage and Adam Copeland) (c) vs. FTR (Cash Wheeler and Dax Harwood) vs. The Young Bucks (Matt Jackson and Nick Jackson)AEW International Championship: Kazuchika Okada (c) vs. Tommaso CiampaAEW Women's World Tag Team Championship - Chicago Street Fight: The Brawling Birds (Alex Windsor and Jamie Hayter) (c) vs. Divine Dominion (Lena Kross and Megan Bayne)AEW World Trios Championship: Swerve Strickland & The New Level (Austin Creed and Kofi) (c) vs. "Hangman" Adam Page & Brodido (Brody King and Bandido)AEW TBS Championship Open Challenge (Excluding Hyan, Maya World, and Thunder Rosa): Persephone (c) vs. TBAAEW Women's World Championship No. 1 Contender Match: Thekla vs. Willow NightingaleAEW World Tag Team Championship No. 1 Contender Match: Darby Allin and Steven Borden vs. The Don Callis Family (Kevin Knight and Kyle Fletcher)AEW National Championship: Andrade El Ídolo (c) def. articles.title: Takuma Inoue recovers from knockdown to repeat win over Tenshin Nasukawa in all-Japanese world title fight
articles.summary: Follow Takuma Inoue vs. Tenshin Nasukawa 2 live results and round-by-round updates for the Inoue vs. Nasukawa fight card on Sunday in Tokyo, Japan.
articles.body: Uncrowned has Takuma Inoue vs. Tenshin Nasukawa 2 live results, round-by-round updates, ring walks and start time for the Inoue vs. Nasukawa fight card on Sunday morning at Toyota Arena in Tokyo, Japan. Takuma Inoue defends his WBC bantamweight title in a rematch with Tenshin Nasukawa in the night's main event.Inoue (22-2, 5 KOs) is the brother of pound-for-pound king Naoya Inoue. He is a two-time bantamweight champion, having previously held the WBA title from 2023 to 2024. Inoue won the vacant WBC belt with a unanimous decision over Nasukawa in November 2025. He has fought once since, retaining his title with a decision over Kazuto Ioka in May.Nasukawa (8-1, 3 KOs) is widely hailed as one of the greatest kickboxers of all time. The Japanese superstar has also fought once since suffering his first career loss against Inoue, stopping Juan Francisco Estrada this past April.The Inoue vs. Nasukawa fight card begins at 4 a.m. ET and can be watched on DAZN. The main event ring walks are expected to take place around 7 a.m. ET.Follow all of the action with Uncrowned's live results and play-by-play of the fight card below.Fight card (4 a.m. ET, DAZN)WBC bantamweight title: Takuma Inoue def. articles.title: Rams vs. Broncos score, live updates: Puka Nacua out for Week 3 Sunday Night Football
articles.summary: Follow along as the Broncos host the Rams on Sunday Night Football in Week 3.
articles.body: The Los Angeles Rams and Denver Broncos are back in primetime for Week 3, closing out a full day of action on "Sunday Night Football." Sean McVay and the Rams bounced back after a slow start in Australia in Week 1, nabbing a decisive 28-6 win over the New York Giants with a stunning offensive performance from reigning MVP Matthew Stafford and All-Pro wideout Davante Adams. Without Puka Nacua (hip) in the lineup, Stafford threw for 327 yards, 4 touchdowns and 1 interception, with Adams reeling in 195 of those yards and two of those scores.The Broncos managed to bounce back from a brutal Week 1 primetime showing of their own last week, as Denver's new wideout Jaylen Waddle shined with 138 receiving yards to give Bo Nix a much-needed offensive boost for a 20-13 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars. Which team will carry that newfound momentum forward into Week 3 to pull out a win in primetime? We'll soon find out.Where to watch Rams vs. Broncos on Sunday Night Football in Week 3Rams-Broncos start time: 8:20 p.m. ETLocation: Mile High Stadium | DenverTV channel/live stream: NBC/PeacockFollow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the Broncos host the Rams on Sunday Night Football.

articles.title: Eagles vs. Bears score, live updates: Jalen Hurts evaluated for concussion, cleared to return
articles.summary: Follow along as the Bears host the Eagles to close out Week 3.
articles.body: The Philadelphia Eagles and Chicago Bears will face off on "Monday Night Football" to close out Week 3 in primetime, with Chicago facing an uphill battle absent starting quarterback Caleb Williams.After a red-hot start to the season where the Bears managed a stunning 59-37 win over the Carolina Panthers, momentum came to a screeching halt as Williams went down with a hamstring injury and was carted off in Week 2. Backup quarterback Tyson Bagent suffered a concussion in his relief and has since cleared concussion protocol, but after missing a chunk of practices, veteran Case Keenum will reportedly get the start against the Eagles on Monday night.Philadelphia hasn't had the most inspiring start to its 2026 season, either, despite their 2-0 start. Their two wins were both close ones, emerging with a mere +6-point combined point differential against the Tennessee Titans and Washington Commanders — two teams that combined for just eight total wins all of last season. Where to watch Eagles vs. Bears tonightEagles-Bears start time: 8:15 p.m. ETLocation: Soldier Field | ChicagoTV channel/live stream: ABC/ESPNFollow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the Bears host the Eagles to close out Week 3.

articles.title: Cam Schlittler's gem, Ben Rice's bat send Yankees soaring past Red Sox, even without Aaron Judge
articles.summary: The Yankees left an ailing Judge off the wild-card roster, hoping they could advance without their MVP. Thanks to a gem from Schlittler and a monster night from Rice, they're halfway to that goal.
articles.body: The New York Yankees left an ailing Aaron Judge off their wild-card roster, hoping that they could advance without him and allow him to heal for the American League Division Series.Thanks to a gem from presumptive Cy Young winner Cam Schlittler and a monster night at the plate from Ben Rice, they're halfway to that goal.Schlittler made the most of a career-high 117 pitches to lead a 9-0 shutout of the Boston Red Sox on Tuesday, giving the Yankees a 1-0 lead in the wild-card series. New York is one win away from eliminating the rival Red Sox in the best-of-three series, with Game 2 scheduled for Wednesday in the Bronx.Schlittler shuts down Sox with career-high pitch countSchlittler led the charge and left the mound with a 2-0 lead in the sixth inning after 107 pitches, his night presumably done. But Aaron Boone wasn't ready to move away from his hard-throwing ace.Schlittler returned for the seventh, with the goal of recording at least one more out. He accomplished that mission, then allowed a one-out single to Wilyer Abreu. Only then was his night over.Reliever Paul Blackburn took Schlittler's place on the mound and ensured that the shutout would remain intact. A double-play ground ball from Ceddanne Rafaela ended the frame with New York's 2-0 lead in place.Schlittler's final line: 6 1/3 innings, 10 strikeouts, 2 hits, 1 walk and 0 runs on 117 pitches.From there, New York's bullpen and the Yankees batters put the game on ice.Yankees bats do their partBen Rice hit a solo home run in the fifth inning, making it 2-0 Yankees. He then put the game out of reach with an eighth-inning grand slam that extended New York's lead to 9-0 and helped the Yankees preserve their bullpen.Rice finished the night 4-for-5 at the plate with 2 home runs, 6 RBI and 2 runs scored.Rookie standout George Lombard Jr., meanwhile, went 3-for-4 with two runs scored in his postseason debut. In total, the Yankees piled up 12 hits and 5 walks as Judge cheered on from the dugout. They did most of their damage against Boston's bullpen after a strong effort from Payton Tolle in his first postseason start. He yielded 5 hits, 1 walk and 1 earned run across 4 2/3 innings.It added up to the exact kind of effort New York was hoping for with Judge relegated to being a spectator. Now they need to do it one more time, with two chances to do so. They'll send three-time All-Star Max Fried (2.80 ERA, 5-5) to the mound in Game 2 on Wednesday. The Red Sox will counter with three-time All-Star Sonny Gray (2.72 ERA, 18-5).Roman Anthony's status unclear due to hand flare-upBoston is unsure about the status of leadoff hitter Roman Anthony, who was subbed out in the sixth inning due to discomfort in his right hand. A ligament injury to the ring finger in the same hand sidelined Anthony for most of the regular season.Manager Chad Tracy told reporters postgame that "his hand flared on him" and that he's unsure if Anthony will need to undergo imaging or will be available Wednesday.

articles.title: Samsung gives its two-year-old Galaxy Tab S Plus an overhaul
articles.summary: The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Tab S12 Ultra are launching together, though the larger Ultra is getting a smaller update.
articles.body: Since the Galaxy Tab S10 line, Samsung has updated its flagship Ultra tablet annually, but alternates its regular and Plus variants. It means that this year’s Galaxy Tab S12 series includes an Ultra model with few changes from last year’s Tab S11 Ultra, and a Plus variant that brings a bigger overhaul to the two-year-old Tab S10 Plus. There’s no regular Tab S12, suggesting fans of the smaller size will have to wait until 2027 for the next version of that tablet. The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus should be a meaningful update to owners of the Tab S10 Plus or older. Compared to that tablet, it has a slightly larger and brighter 12.6-inch display, despite running thinner and lighter overall. The MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset is two generations ahead of the old 9300 Plus, and the 10,600mAh battery is bigger too. It’s all enough to make the $200 cost increase, to a new starting price of $1,199, feel worthwhile. By contrast, the Tab S12 Ultra is altogether more familiar, though only because it benefited from those design upgrades last year. Compared to the Tab S11 Ultra, the only real changes are the annual chipset bump and upgraded four-channel spatial audio (also found on the Plus). The Ultra’s 14.6-inch display, 11,600mAh battery, and 5.1mm-thick design are all unchanged year-on-year. That would be easier to swallow if it didn’t also come at a $200 premium, now $1,399. [Image: [Image: [Image: Both tablets benefit from bright OLED displays with 1,600 nits of peak brightness, IP68 ratings, and seven years of Android updates. An S Pen stylus comes in the box, as does a welcome software update: the Android debut of Adobe Photoshop for Tablets, which will be a Galaxy Store exclusive for six months. It comes with Adobe’s AI features, a tablet-optimized interface, and support for the S Pen. [Image: The Android tablet version of Photoshop will be exclusive to Samsung for six months. The Galaxy Tab S12 Plus and Tab S12 Ultra will hit shelves on October 7th.

articles.title: Amazon’s new Fire TV Stick 4K can pull power directly from your TV
articles.summary: Amazon launched a new Fire TV Stick 4K with support for direct power from TVs and a slimmer design, along with a redesigned Fire TV remote.
articles.body: The new Fire TV Stick 4K will be a little easier to set up than Amazon’s previous 4K streaming sticks since it no longer requires a power adapter. You can power the device directly from your TV’s USB port, like the updated entry-level Fire TV Stick Amazon launched earlier this year. The Fire TV Stick 4K, available starting today for $59.99, runs on Amazon’s refreshed TV OS and includes Wi-Fi 6, Bluetooth 5.3, and Bluetooth Low Energy. Amazon’s also simplifying its streaming stick lineup, which now includes four devices instead of five: the Fire TV Stick HD, Fire TV Stick 4K, Fire TV Stick 4K Max, and Fire TV Cube. The new Fire TV Stick 4K is replacing Amazon’s earlier “Select” and “Plus” 4K streaming sticks. [Image: Amazon’s Fire TV streaming device lineup no longer includes the 4K “Select” and “Plus” sticks. A redesigned Fire TV Remote is launching alongside the new streaming stick, featuring a new asymmetrical shape and “more tactile controls.” The new remote is compatible with all Amazon Ember TVs and Fire TV streaming devices from 2019 onward. It will be available standalone for $14.99 and starts shipping late October. Amazon says it also plans to launch a “Plus” version of the new remote early next year, with an aluminum design, backlit buttons, and a “Find My Remote” feature. Fire TV is getting a few software updates, as well, including an Alexa Plus Hub and an Alexa Plus integration in the Fire TV mobile app. Amazon says its AI “now draws on real-world context” like awards and events, helping it answer more complex prompts for show and movie suggestions. Amazon Music is also getting a new Fire TV app later this fall, with an Alexa Plus integration users can prompt for music and podcast recommendations.

articles.title: State GST joint commissioner suspended in ₹2.89cr DA case
articles.summary: Kerala State GST joint commissioner Prajani Rajan suspended after VACB raid in ₹2.89 crore disproportionate assets case; cash, dollars and documents seized.
articles.body: Thiruvananthapuram: State GST joint commissioner Prajani Rajan was suspended late Wednesday following a vigilance case alleging that she accumulated assets worth Rs 2.89 crore disproportionate to her known sources of income between Jan 1, 2014, and Dec 1, 2024. Following a vigilance raid, chief minister V D Satheesan directed her immediate suspension. Rajan is posted as joint commissioner (taxpayer service) at the state GST office in Thevara, Ernakulam.Secretary (taxes) N Prasanth issued the suspension order based on the vigilance director’s report dated Sept 29. Vigilance and Anti-Corruption Bureau (VACB) conducted a preliminary enquiry before registering the case against her under the Prevention of Corruption Act. It seized Rs 14.10 lakh in unaccounted cash and $788 from her Pachalam residence during the investigation, according to vigilance sources.The agency also recovered documents relating to property, title deeds and financial transactions, which will be produced before Muvattupuzha vigilance court. Vigilance sources said the probe also found a fixed deposit of around Rs 2.5 crore in her name. VACB had recommended her suspension, citing that her continuation in service could hamper the investigation.Stay updated with the latest Thiruvananthapuram news. Download the TOI App.

articles.title: The new and huger Paramount has a new co-CEO
articles.summary: Paramount is appointing Ynon Kreiz, previously Mattel’s chairman and CEO, to be Paramount’s co-CEO alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison.
articles.body: Paramount is appointing a new co-CEO ahead of the close of its $110 billion merger with Warner Bros. Discovery. Ynon Kreiz, previously Mattel’s chairman and CEO, will be joining Paramount to lead alongside chairman and CEO David Ellison. According to Paramount, “Ellison will focus on the company’s long-term strategy, creative vision and direction, including its talent relationships, strategic partnerships, technology and capital allocation. Kreiz will focus on the company’s day-to-day management and integration of the combined businesses.” The combined Paramount and Warner Bros. Discovery will “report jointly” to Ellison and Kreiz. Kreiz joined Mattel in 2018. While he was leading the company, it launched the hit Barbie film in partnership with Warner Bros. Pictures. His first day at Paramount is October 5th. Today, a judge also approved Paramount’s recently-announced settlement in a lawsuit with several states that had been blocking the Warner Bros. Discovery merger, according to Reuters. On Tuesday, Paramount’s streaming chief, Cindy Holland, announced that she would be stepping down, and Variety reports that HBO boss Casey Bloys is “poised” to take over both Paramount Plus and HBO.

articles.title: AEW Dynamite results, grades (Sept. 30): Bryan Danielson returns on emotional night of tributes to PAC
articles.summary: Wednesday's "AEW Dynamite" was dedicated to the late, great Benjamin "PAC" Satterley, after his tragic and untimely passing at the age of 40.
articles.body: "AEW Dynamite" was in Pittsburgh at the Petersen Events Center on this Wednesday, Sept. 30. The show was dedicated to the late, great Benjamin "PAC" Satterley after his tragic and untimely passing at the age of 40 this past Sunday.Gravity forgot, we won'tIt's hard to know where to begin after a night like this. Once again, AEW was put in the bittersweet position of delivering a beautiful tribute to a wrestler no longer with us. But truly, no one does it quite like them. And with the loss still being so fresh, having last seen PAC perform just this past Saturday at AEW All Out 2026, it's miraculous that everyone involved tonight kept it together as well as they did.The night began with the AEW roster in the entryway for the 10-bell salute after Excalibur and Tony Schiavone shared emotional words with the viewers and crowd. Throughout the night, we were treated to pre-recorded video messages from several wrestlers remembering the "Bastard," including the likes of "Hangman" Adam Page, Cash Wheeler, Jay White, Ricochet, Will Ospreay, Swerve Strickland and Darby Allin. All were tear-jerking in their own unique ways, showing exactly how pivotal a role Satterley played in everyone's lives.Forever our Bastard. Your favorite wrestler's favorite wrestler. There will never be another like him. One day, we will meet again. We love you, Ben. We miss you. 🖤 pic.twitter.com/Z3hBrg6a5N— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 We love you, Ben. We miss you. We always will. 🖤 pic.twitter.com/EIANsSNnTb— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 "He cared about everyone so much. And I am going to miss him. Thank you, Ben. Good bye."We love you, Ben. We always will. 🖤 pic.twitter.com/YFLaHm20iX— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 "Whether we were fighting on a golf course, or him throwing me through a flaming table... here he is, playing in the sand..."We love you, Ben. We always will. 🖤 pic.twitter.com/XbN2hixUR0— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 We even had a message from Satterley's family read by Renee Paquette. That was a proper heartbreaker, but major props to her for holding it together and to AEW for putting something like that on the show..@ReneePaquette reads a statement from the Satterley family on the late, great @BastardPAC. pic.twitter.com/1s2GuZTrKC— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 The first match of the night saw two key figures in PAC's AEW career go at it, as Jon Moxley defeated Orange Cassidy to retain his Continental title.Afterward, Bryan Danielson made a surprise appearance, which turned into an in-ring return for one night only in the main event. It was magic.Bryan Danielson is here, and he and Jon Moxley embrace!Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/aixStps1nq— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 BRYAN DANIELSON IS TEAMING UP WITH THE DEATH RIDERS TO HONOR PAC!Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/sHfsD6k2bn— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 Danielson teamed up with his old Death Rider/Blackpool Combat Club squad to beat The Don Callis Family, which included another return in the form of Wardlow.The big man was teased to be on his way back in a vignette on Saturday, but no one expected it to be tonight. He got his fair share of licks in, but the match overall was about highlighting the Death Riders, with several in-ring tributes to PAC.That was the theme throughout the night, as Marina Shafir scored the win via PAC's patented Brutalizer submission in her prior match alongside Thunder Rosa and Hyan against Dr. Britt Baker DMD, Persephone and Mercedes Moné.The Brutalizer! @MarinaShafir escapes @RealBrittBaker and gets the win!Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/0cSVoN0ShB— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 Right in the feelsAs the first announced match for Wednesday's show, Ospreay and Ricochet were destined to work their magic, as they typically do together. Their match was excellent, but nothing was better than the finish.Ospreay had Ricochet dead in the water after a Hidden Blade to the back of the dome. Instead, he looked up to the top rope and performed PAC's signature Black Arrow finish before erupting with emotion. Man. What a scene.BLACK ARROW FROM @WILLOSPREAY! 🖤🖤🖤Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/F84UDsYyBu— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 What a match. What a moment.We love you, Ben. 🖤Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/vyHlpgTbDX— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 👑 Uncrowned gem of the night 👑AEW aired its very last footage of PAC before the aforementioned 10-bell salute. It was a promo cut by Moxley following his loss to Ospreay at All Out. Given its substance, it was eerie but sensational, as he spoke about eulogies and death. Almost poetically, PAC was the last to be seen on camera, too. Wild.“Anybody else who has the guts to do what it takes to be great... to really be great.”After #AEWAllOut, @JonMoxley reflects with raw honesty, hard-earned perspective, and a reminder that greatness comes with a cost.Watch #AEWDynamite A Tribute to PAC on TBS & HBO Max pic.twitter.com/PW9VafMFFa— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 In the end, the ultimate highlight package closed out the night, reminding us all exactly how incredible Benjamin Satterley was inside and outside of the ring.The very, very best of us. Truly one of a kind.We love you so, so much, Ben. We miss you so, so much. We always will. 🖤 pic.twitter.com/pi0XkfZKAn— All Elite Wrestling (@AEW) October 1, 2026 This "AEW Dynamite" served its purpose to the fullest extent: Honoring one of its best. I give this "AEW Dynamite" a crown score of: 10/10 👑AEW Dynamite full card results and match grades:Death Riders (Claudio Castagnoli, Wheeler Yuta, Gabe Kidd, Daniel Garcia and Bryan Danielson) def. articles.title: Reggie quits Twitch after explosive Kai Cenat fallout, claims he was ‘blackballed’ and moves content to YouTube
articles.summary: Twitch streamer Reginald “Reggie,” also known as “Lil Rodney Son,” says he is done streaming on Twitch after a fallout involving Kai Cenat.
articles.body: Twitch streamer Reginald “Reggie,” also known as “Lil Rodney Son,” says he is done streaming on Twitch after a fallout involving Kai Cenat. During an Instagram livestream on September 30, Reggie claimed Kai “runs Twitch” and accused him of “blackballing” people, saying he would move his content to YouTube. He later explained the decision in his YouTube video THE TRUTH ABOUT EVERYTHING PART 2, saying he feels hurt and unsupported. Reggie said he still has content obligations but needs time for himself. Kai has separately said he plans to take legal action over Reggie’s allegations.Reggie says Kai Cenat’s influence led him to leave TwitchReggie explained his Twitch exit during an Instagram livestream, saying he no longer wanted to stream on a platform where he believed Kai had too much influence. A clip from the livestream was later shared on X by @scubaryan_.Reggie said:“But understand this one thing: Kai, he runs Twitch, and that’s why I can’t be over there no more. I’m never gonna stream on Twitch again. So, if y’all want to find my content, y’all gonna have to catch me on YouTube. I will never stream on Twitch again because Kai runs that app so much that he’s—he’s, he’s, he’s, what’s the word? What’s the word? What’s the word? What’s the word? He’s blackballing people, right? He’s blackballing people, right?”Reggie’s comments came during an ongoing dispute with Kai and members of the Clover Boys. He has made several allegations involving Kai in recent days, including claims connected to RaKai. Those claims have not been independently established.Kai has pushed back against Reggie’s allegations and said he plans to sue him over his statements. Kai also asked Reggie to provide evidence for the claims made against him.Reggie says he needs time after the Kai Cenat controversyReggie also addressed his decision in his YouTube video THE TRUTH ABOUT EVERYTHING PART 2. Near the end, he shared a written message explaining how the situation had affected him and why he wanted to step away.He wrote:“Just to let y'all know, I will no longer be streaming on Twitch. I can't continue streaming on a platform where I don't feel supported or comfortable being myself. Yes, I'm really hurt, and at some point I need to take time to heal, and I'm going to do that on my own time and in my own way. I still have obligations to people when it comes to content, and I'm going to handle those responsibilities, but after this, I honestly don't know if I'll ever want to create content again. The whole point of doing this was to feel loved and supported, especially by people I considered my brothers. It hurts when people act like they care about you when you feel like they don't. Nobody should ever have to feel like they're being lied to, whether it's on camera or off camera. I appreciate everyone who has genuinely supported me and showed me real love, but right now I just need some time for myself. #ProtectTheKids.”For now, Reggie has pointed viewers toward YouTube rather than announcing that he is leaving content creation completely. His message also makes clear that he intends to finish existing content obligations before deciding what he wants to do next.You use AI every day. Now get your AI Quotient. Take the AIQ test.

articles.body:
Westlake and Round Rock meet Thursday at Chaparral Stadium in the biggest high school football matchup in Central Texas so far this season.

It's the District 25-6A opener for Westlake (3-1), which is coming off a 49-6 win over Midland Lee in its final nondistrict contest. Round Rock (4-1) started its district slate last week with a 45-25 win over Stony Point. The Dragons arguably have the two best wins in the Austin area this year after beating Dripping Springs and Vandegrift.

The teams meet for the first time in a district contest since 1987.

Both programs are in the American-Statesman's top five power rankings for 6A, and the winner takes a giant step toward the district title. Kickoff is set for 6 p.m.

The all clear has been given and kickoff will be at 6:30 p.m.

articles.title: Phillies vs. Braves live updates, starting pitchers, where to watch: Aaron Nola, Ray Kerr to start Game 3 of wild-card series
articles.summary: The Phillies forced a Game 3 against the Braves with a 4-3 win in extras on Wednesday.
articles.body: The Philadelphia Phillies saved their season on Wednesday in their National League wild-card series against the division-rival Atlanta Braves.Alec Bohm and Andrew Painter came to the rescue in Game 2. That is, after Kyle Schwarber and Bryce Harper launched back-to-back homers to tie the game 3-3 in the eighth inning. Then Painter, a rookie right-handed starter, spun three scoreless innings of relief in his postseason debut, and Bohm went the opposite way for a go-ahead solo shot in the 10th. Philadelphia's thrilling 4-3 victory tied the series 1-1. On Thursday, the Braves will try to bounce back and win their first playoff series since they won the 2021 World Series. During that drought, the Phillies have ousted Atlanta twice, first in the 2022 NLDS and again in the 2023 NLDS.The Braves, this year's NL East champions, are opening with lefty reliever Ray Kerr yet could quickly hand the ball to right-handed starter Grant Holmes. Philadelphia, meanwhile, is trotting out right-handed starter Aaron Nola, the club's longest-tenured player. It's possible that the Phillies will eventually deploy righty standout Zack Wheeler as a reliever.Whoever emerges from the winner-take-all matchup will have a date with the two-time defending World Series champion Los Angeles Dodgers in the NLDS.Where to watch Phillies-Braves in Game 3Phillies-Braves start time: 8 p.m. ETLocation: Truist Park | AtlantaTV channel/live stream: PeacockFollow along with Yahoo Sports for live updates, highlights and more as the Braves and Phillies face off in Game 3 for a bid to the NLDS.

articles.title: Deshaun Watson rallies Browns to a field goal in final seconds to beat the Steelers
articles.summary: The Steelers rallied after a bad first half against the Browns.
articles.body: A little more than a month ago, Cleveland Browns fans booed Deshaun Watson, and Watson shot back at the fans. It was the low point of a toxic relationship. On Thursday night, Browns fans weren't booing. Watson came through when it mattered as he did in each of the Browns' previous two games. After Aaron Rodgers and the Pittsburgh Steelers scored a touchdown and 2-point conversion to tie Thursday night's game in the final two minutes, Watson had a shot to make up for what to that point had been a rough second half. Watson completed enough passes to get kicker Andre Szmyt close enough to try a 56-yard field goal, and he hit it with 10 seconds left to give the Browns a 27-24 win. Cleveland is 3-1 and in sole possession of first place in the AFC North, at least for a few days. "It was electric. It was amazing. This is what it's all about," Watson told Amazon Prime Video after the game. "Nights like this, in Cleveland, in front of our home fans, getting them Ws, getting them wins, this is what it's all about."In the Browns' second preseason game Watson struggled, was booed, then said it was disrespectful of Browns fans to do so. That seemed like it could be the end of a tumultuous relationship. But the Browns stuck with Watson, even though there were plenty of reasons to move on. Now the Browns are 3-1, with three straight wins, and nobody is talking about benching Watson. Browns dominate first halfThe Steelers scored first, and then the Browns took over the rest of the half. Cleveland was moving the ball at will on Pittsburgh. Watson had what might have been the best half he has had with the Browns. He completed 14 of 17 passes for 181 yards and a touchdown in the first half. His 2-yard touchdown pass to tight end Harold Fannin Jr. gave the Browns a 21-7 lead. Watson was in control. He was spreading it around but mostly finding a talented pair of rookie receivers. Second-round draft pick Denzel Boston had 74 yards on three catches in the first half and first-round pick KC Concepcion had 58 yards on four catches.Since the Browns' oft-maligned trade for Watson in 2022, the offense has rarely looked good. Cleveland has suffered through so many bad quarterbacks through the years, the first half had to be unrecognizable to Browns fans. Of course, the struggles of the Steelers' defense played its part in that. At one point Amazon Prime Video showed T.J. Watt making the unusual move of grabbing a headset from an assistant on the sideline and then was in a heated discussion with the coaches up in the press box. Getting picked apart by Watson was driving Watt and the Steelers mad. Pittsburgh's defense was much better in the second half. Browns stall, Steelers get back in itWatt tried to get the Steelers back in the game in the third quarter. He had a great play to strip Watson on a run-pass option and recovered the fumble himself. But his offense couldn't move the ball and punted after a sack. A great challenge by the Steelers' coaches in the fourth quarter got Pittsburgh back in the game. The Steelers got an interception downfield but there was clear defensive pass interference. Pittsburgh challenged, saying linebacker Jack Sawyer tipped Watson's pass. When a pass is tipped, there can be no pass interference afterward. The replay review showed the ball was tipped, so not only was the pass interference penalty wiped out but the interception stood. The Steelers drove down after that pick and scored their first touchdown since the first drive of the game, on a nice Rodgers pass to tight end Darnell Washington. The Steelers didn't get the 2-point conversion but trailed just 21-16.The Browns finally got their first points of the second half on a field goal, pushing the lead to eight points. The Steelers punted quickly but downed a punt at the 1-yard line. Watson had Fannin wide open for what would have been a key first down but he missed him badly and Cleveland punted. Rodgers had 3:32 to get the Steelers a touchdown and 2-point conversion. Rodgers immediately completed a couple of passes to get into Browns territory, and then another pass to DK Metcalf got Pittsburgh to the 12-yard line. Rodgers kept throwing jump balls to Washington and finally on fourth down they drew a penalty to keep the drive alive. The next play, tight end Pat Freiermuth caught a touchdown. The Steelers went for 2 and the tie, and after an offsides penalty Rodgers got in on a sneak to even up the game. Watson moved the Browns into field-goal range, but took a sack that pushed Cleveland back a bit. Then he had a terrible third-down pass, and that left Szmyt to attempt a 56-yard field goal with 15 seconds left. Szmyt hit it. Rodgers' ensuing desperate pass downfield was picked off and the Browns had the win. "Just belief, hope, determination," Watson said, when asked on Amazon Prime Video what he sees in his teammates. "Those guys look at me and they want me to lead the ship. I just told them, 'Believe in me, do what I ask and I'm going to make a play when the opportunity comes.'"The Browns are on a roll. Nobody expected Watson to be leading a first-place team after four weeks of the season.

articles.title: Microsoft AI launches MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming alongside multilingual MAI-Voice 2.1 models
articles.summary: Microsoft has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming model, with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, calling it the most accurate real-time audio
articles.body: Microsoft has launched MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming model, with Microsoft AI CEO Mustafa Suleyman, calling it the most accurate real-time audio transcription model in the world. Unveiled alongside two companion speech generation models – MAI-Voice-2.1 and the high-speed MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash – the release is designed to provide developers with responsive, low-cost building blocks for building autonomous conversational voice agents.According to Suleyman, the new voice architecture delivers inference speeds that are 55% faster and operational costs that are 60% cheaper than comparable offerings like ElevenLabs. He said in a post on X (formerly Twitter): “We're launching the most accurate real time transcription model in the world... #1 !!! 55% faster and 60% cheaper than ElevenLabs. Come build agents on our platform!”Real-time speech recognition: MAI-Transcribe-2-StreamingThe headline addition to the company’s audio lineup, MAI-Transcribe-2-Streaming, provides continuous, low-latency live speech-to-text across 60 languages with built-in automatic language detection. Key performance benchmarks and features include top benchmark ranking as the model has secured the No. 1 spot for accuracy across both partial and completed transcripts on the independent benchmark platform Artificial Analysis.It sits on the Pareto frontier for accuracy versus latency, eliminating the historical tradeoff where high precision required sluggish processing times. Instead of pausing until a sentence ends, the model outputs initial text hypotheses within roughly 100 milliseconds of receiving incoming audio. It refines words as additional context arrives and finalizes stable text immediately.By surfacing partial transcripts as words are spoken, voice bots can trigger API tools and start logical reasoning before the user finishes speaking. For live captioning and automated dictation workflows, internal tests show text appears on-screen twice as fast as the nearest market competitor.Natural Multilingual Output: MAI-Voice-2.1To pair with speech recognition, the team introduced MAI-Voice-2.1, its flagship multilingual text-to-speech engine covering 23 languages and 26 regional locales.The system's standout capability is cross-lingual identity preservation. A single synthetic voice persona can switch seamlessly between diverse languages, such as English, Mandarin and German, without carrying a foreign accent over from one language to another. Instead, the synthesized speaker modifies actual local pronunciation and retains a unique vocal identity.That means brands can deploy uniform virtual ambassadors worldwide, educational sites can switch languages while keeping the same instructors, and customer support agents can respond in the caller’s language without missing a beat.MAI-Voice-2.1-Flash Low-Latency ScaleMAI-Voice-2.1-Flash was introduced by the company for mission-critical, high-capacity applications that demand immediate response times.The Flash version offers the same 23-language voice consistency as the base model, but it is optimized for high-throughput enterprise workloads, and can produce 45 seconds of synthesized audio with an end-to-end latency of just 150 milliseconds.You use AI every day. When a pass is tipped, there can be no pass interference afterward. The replay review showed the ball was tipped, so not only was the pass interference penalty wiped out but the interception stood. The Steelers drove down after that pick and scored their first touchdown since the first drive of the game, on a nice Rodgers pass to tight end Darnell Washington. The Steelers didn't get the 2-point conversion but trailed just 21-16.The Browns finally got their first points of the second half on a field goal, pushing the lead to eight points. The Steelers punted quickly but downed a punt at the 1-yard line. Watson had Fannin wide open for what would have been a key first down but he missed him badly and Cleveland punted. Rodgers had 3:32 to get the Steelers a touchdown and 2-point conversion. Rodgers immediately completed a couple of passes to get into Browns territory, and then another pass to DK Metcalf got Pittsburgh to the 12-yard line. Rodgers kept throwing jump balls to Washington and finally on fourth down they drew a penalty to keep the drive alive. The next play, tight end Pat Freiermuth caught a touchdown. The Steelers went for 2 and the tie, and after an offsides penalty Rodgers got in on a sneak to even up the game. Watson moved the Browns into field-goal range, but took a sack that pushed Cleveland back a bit. Then he had a terrible third-down pass, and that left Szmyt to attempt a 56-yard field goal with 15 seconds left. Szmyt hit it. Rodgers' ensuing desperate pass downfield was picked off and the Browns had the win. "Just belief, hope, determination," Watson said, when asked on Amazon Prime Video what he sees in his teammates. "Those guys look at me and they want me to lead the ship. I just told them, 'Believe in me, do what I ask and I'm going to make a play when the opportunity comes.'"The Browns are on a roll. Nobody expected Watson to be leading a first-place team after four weeks of the season.
